supplement_sections.purpose: Define the hard-grounded taxonomy, source datasets, rubrics, and construct operationalization.
Document composition, licensing, package policy, exact artifact hashes, and citation caveats.
Define model input/output, scoring metrics, result reporting, qualitative error codes, and baseline import surfaces.
Tie manuscript tables and claims to current evidence and blocked claims.
Expose reviewer workflow, remaining workload, acceptance gates, blockers, and validity risks.
Record start-here reproduction commands, package-critical hashes, and current release readiness state.

paper_tables.title: Benchmark Taxonomy and Construct Operationalization
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Each hard-grounded category is tied to source datasets, rubric dimensions, target metrics, novelty risk, and reviewed-gold coverage.

paper_tables.title: Pilot Baseline Macro Results
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Current pilot results for oracle sanity, non-oracle heuristics, and imported external model reports. Intervals are descriptive over the 30-item pilot.

paper_tables.title: Challenge-Type Diagnostic Matrix
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Per-system challenge slices showing whether failures are concentrated in temporal, authority, contradiction, overreach, lifecycle, insufficiency, native, or stale/current probes.

paper_tables.title: Observed Pilot Failure Modes
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Cross-system qualitative failure modes extracted from scored pilot reports. These are diagnostic examples, not final human-reviewed claims.

paper_tables.title: Allowed and Prohibited Novelty Claims
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Current June 2026 related-work registry boundaries. Final novelty remains blocked until the literature audit is refreshed before submission.

paper_tables.title: Remaining Paper-Readiness Blockers
paper_tables.manuscript_use: Current release-gate blockers that prevent treating the pilot package as a completed benchmark paper.

claim_map.claim: The benchmark operationalizes 10 hard-grounded research categories beyond simple fact lookup.
The benchmark is grounded in Hugging Face datasets and fetched source rows rather than only hand-written toy examples.
evidence: 246/246 distinct fetched source rows; known_license=174; pointer_only=72

claim_map.claim: The current artifacts define a large-corpus source-diversity target and executable acquisition substrate.
Pilot baselines expose qualitative failure modes that motivate the hard-grounded taxonomy.
Category-level differences identify which grounded-research tasks are hardest.
evidence: 0/300 valid reviewed target items; 300 reviewed items still needed

claim_map.claim: The benchmark has publishable gold labels for paper-scale evaluation.
The annotation workflow has pre-registered quality-control rules for reviewer eligibility and label admissibility.
The benchmark is genuinely novel as of June 2026 and ready for completion/submission.
